VIBE: CHEEKY

Not fun at minute seven. Still possibly worth doing.

HOOK
Some valuable experiences are satisfying in retrospect and annoying in minute seven.

PREDICT
Predict whether the activity is meant to feel pleasant now or meaningful afterward.

PLAY
Take one effortful valued activity. Rate PLEASURE DURING and WORTH AFTER separately.

CATCH
Notice whether one low number had been cancelling the other dimension.

REVEAL
Pleasure and meaning are related but distinct components of wellbeing.

MIND BEND
A good life contains experiences that are not all trying to be a good mood.

VIBE: CHEEKY

Winner got prettier; runner-up suddenly developed flaws.

HOOK
Once you choose, your brain may help you live with it by moving the ratings apart.

PREDICT
Predict how you rated the winner and runner-up before the decision.

PLAY
For a recent close choice, reconstruct the pre-choice pros of the rejected option and cons of the chosen one before reading your current story.

CATCH
Notice whether the alternatives have drifted apart after commitment.

REVEAL
Post-decision dissonance can increase liking of chosen options and decrease liking of rejected ones.

MIND BEND
A decision can change your preferences after it stops measuring them.
